promptEs: En Si♭ mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/V?
promptEn: In B♭ major, which degree does V/V resolve to?
explanationEs: En Si♭ mayor, V/V es Do7 y resuelve en Fa (V). Su tercera es la sensible de Fa y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In B♭ major, V/V is C7 and it resolves to F (V). Its third is the leading tone of F and rises a semitone when it resolves.
